title: Retain native parallel publication after the high-file-count holdout
question: Does the native plain publication opt-in save whole-job time with realistic input and more output files?
summary: The existing native four-slot opt-in clears the elapsed and CPU gates at 1,152 output files on Linux/WSL and native Windows, and at 192 files in the Linux control.

workloads: 2 GiB plain snapshot Partition on WSL ext4 and Windows NTFS.

validation.summary: Twelve jobs verified exact groups, per-key order, caps, conservation, atomic output and cleanup.

limitations: One physical host, one workload family and four configured workers.
exclusions: Generic worker or file-count Auto promotion and physical throughput.
reopen_when: Calibrate pressure and concurrent owner behavior for a proposed automatic selector.
